rows.title: Waiting on design: address search's search-only layout, results as the trader types, reveal on a pick and its announcements, in the address book and the commercial transporter form
rows.detail: The postcode lookup on the consignee, importer and place of destination add-address pages: an 'Enter address manually' link at every lookup step, the uses checkboxes and save buttons only on the address form, and an error for an empty postcode. Address search is parked until it is planned and the address lookup is a real feature, so this stays in the existing deferred waiting-on-design row.
acceptanceCriteria: The postcode step, the 'Select an address' page and the no-addresses page each show an 'Enter address manually' link, which opens the role's add-address form with empty fields under the same heading as the postcode step (prototype:dr2-1-source p8-170, p8-172, p8-173; trace:prototype-dr2-1 p7-045, p7-055, p7-058, p7-066; prototype:dr2-1-specs p4-069, p4-075, p4-088, p4-090; ruling:sam-2026-10-09 p1-178, p1-180)

On the consignee, importer and place of destination pages the 'Add to your address book' checkboxes and the save buttons show on the add-address form, and the postcode step and the 'Select an address' page show only the lookup and its own button (prototype:dr2-1-source p8-182; trace:prototype-dr2-1 p7-044, p7-058; ruling:sam-2026-10-09 p1-178, p1-180)

Pressing 'Find address' with no postcode shows the error 'Enter a postcode', linked to the postcode field, and the browser title starts 'Error: ' (prototype:dr2-1-source p8-174; trace:prototype-dr2-1 p7-049; prototype:dr2-1-specs p4-072; ruling:sam-2026-10-09 p1-178, p1-180)
rows.notes: Combiner: keep the existing deferred row inc-194 exactly as it is: its id, text, requirements, theme, dependsOn and externalDependsOn. It already holds req-652, req-653 and req-654 beside this area's req-649 and req-1957, and a deferred row is never rewritten on a re-distil. This draft only records that the three requirements still to build from this area sit there. All three carry blockedBy: ruling:sam-2026-11-09 points 2 and 3 park address search as concept work not needed for the deadline, and it waits on the INS backend's address lookup becoming a real feature. Touches are left empty: the lookup and add pages it would change sit in the address-book split-off theme's code (insfrontend features/address-book/add and services/address-lookup), and inc-194 reaches them only through its externalDependsOn.
